queries.catalog:
BEGIN READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '5000ms';
SELECT 'access' AS section, jsonb_build_object('bypass_rls', r.rolbypassrls, 'can_create_role', r.rolcreaterole,
 'row_security', current_setting('row_security')) AS metadata FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=current_user
UNION ALL
SELECT 'tables', jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'select_allowed',has_table_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'SELECT'),
 'rls_enabled',c.relrowsecurity,'rls_forced',c.relforcerowsecurity,'rls_active_for_role',row_security_active(c.oid))
FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('users','roles','oauth_accounts','refresh_tokens','security_events','otp_challenges','password_reset_tokens','carts','wishlists','email_deliveries','_prisma_migrations')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'columns', jsonb_build_object('table',table_name,'column',column_name,'type',data_type)
FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public'
AND table_name IN ('users','roles','oauth_accounts','refresh_tokens','security_events','otp_challenges','password_reset_tokens','carts','wishlists','email_deliveries','_prisma_migrations')
AND column_name IN ('id','userId','email','pendingEmail','providerAccountId','provider','createdAt','updatedAt','expiresAt','isRevoked','familyId','recipient','type','started_at','finished_at','rolled_back_at','migration_name','checksum','applied_steps_count')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'foreign_keys', jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'constraint',con.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid))
FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname='public' AND con.contype='f'
AND c.relname IN ('oauth_accounts','refresh_tokens','security_events','otp_challenges','password_reset_tokens','carts','wishlists','email_deliveries')
ORDER BY section;
ROLLBACK;
queries.counts:
BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '5000ms';
SET LOCAL TIME ZONE 'UTC';
WITH bounds AS (SELECT timestamp '2026-10-13 12:31:00' AS lo, timestamp '2026-10-13 12:39:00' AS hi),
synthetic_users AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT u.id,u."createdAt" FROM public.users u WHERE u.email ~* '^(google-|local-google-|admin-google-|link-google-)[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}@electrohub-test[.]invalid$' OR u."pendingEmail" ~* '^(google-|local-google-|admin-google-|link-google-)[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}@electrohub-test[.]invalid$' LIMIT 1001
), synthetic_oauth AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT o.id,o."userId",o."createdAt" FROM public.oauth_accounts o WHERE o.provider::text='GOOGLE' AND o."providerAccountId" ~* '^(google-|local-|admin-|http-link-)[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' LIMIT 1001
), incident_users AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT id FROM synthetic_users,bounds WHERE "createdAt">=lo AND "createdAt"<hi
 UNION SELECT "userId" FROM synthetic_oauth,bounds WHERE "createdAt">=lo AND "createdAt"<hi
)
SELECT 'snapshot' AS object_class, jsonb_build_object('observed_at',clock_timestamp(),'read_only',current_setting('transaction_read_only')) AS counts
UNION ALL SELECT 'synthetic_users', jsonb_build_object('incident_window',count(*) FILTER(WHERE "createdAt">=lo AND "createdAt"<hi),'before_window',count(*) FILTER(WHERE "createdAt"<lo),'after_window',count(*) FILTER(WHERE "createdAt">=hi),'cap_reached',count(*)>=1001) FROM synthetic_users CROSS JOIN bounds
UNION ALL SELECT 'synthetic_oauth', jsonb_build_object('incident_window',count(*) FILTER(WHERE "createdAt">=lo AND "createdAt"<hi),'before_window',count(*) FILTER(WHERE "createdAt"<lo),'after_window',count(*) FILTER(WHERE "createdAt">=hi),'cap_reached',count(*)>=1001) FROM synthetic_oauth CROSS JOIN bounds
UNION ALL SELECT 'incident_linked_users', jsonb_build_object('total',count(*)) FROM incident_users
UNION ALL SELECT 'oauth_accounts', jsonb_build_object('related_total',count(*)) FROM public.oauth_accounts WHERE "userId" IN (SELECT id FROM incident_users)
UNION ALL SELECT 'refresh_tokens', jsonb_build_object('related_total',count(*),'revoked',count(*) FILTER(WHERE "isRevoked"),'unrevoked_unexpired',count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT "isRevoked" AND "expiresAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) FROM public.refresh_tokens WHERE "userId" IN (SELECT id FROM incident_users)
UNION ALL SELECT 'security_events', jsonb_build_object('related_total',count(*)) FROM public.security_events WHERE "userId" IN (SELECT id FROM incident_users)
UNION ALL SELECT 'otp_challenges', jsonb_build_object('related_total',count(*)) FROM public.otp_challenges WHERE "userId" IN (SELECT id FROM incident_users)
UNION ALL SELECT 'password_reset_tokens', jsonb_build_object('related_total',count(*)) FROM public.password_reset_tokens WHERE "userId" IN (SELECT id FROM incident_users)
UNION ALL SELECT 'carts', jsonb_build_object('related_total',count(*)) FROM public.carts WHERE "userId" IN (SELECT id FROM incident_users)
UNION ALL SELECT 'wishlists', jsonb_build_object('related_total',count(*)) FROM public.wishlists WHERE "userId" IN (SELECT id FROM incident_users)
UNION ALL SELECT 'email_deliveries', jsonb_build_object('related_total',count(*)) FROM public.email_deliveries WHERE "userId" IN (SELECT id FROM incident_users)
UNION ALL SELECT 'detached_synthetic_email_deliveries_in_window', jsonb_build_object('total',count(*)) FROM public.email_deliveries,bounds WHERE "userId" IS NULL AND recipient ~* '^(google-|local-google-|admin-google-|link-google-)[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}@electrohub-test[.]invalid$' AND "createdAt">=lo AND "createdAt"<hi
UNION ALL SELECT 'detached_google_security_events_in_window', jsonb_build_object('total',count(*),'attribution','UNKNOWN unless owner audit links deleted fixture') FROM public.security_events,bounds WHERE "userId" IS NULL AND type::text='GOOGLE_CONNECTED' AND "createdAt">=lo AND "createdAt"<hi
ORDER BY object_class;
ROLLBACK;
